title: Libraries and study rooms in Kozhikode
description: Explore libraries, reading rooms and paid study spaces in Kozhikode, with access notes and map searches.
intro: Whether you want to borrow a book or bring your own work to a quiet desk, these places serve different needs. Check membership, seat availability and current fees with the venue before visiting. Map links are searches rather than verified pins.

ordering.explanation: Alphabetical by venue: libraries and paid study spaces serve different needs and available evidence does not support a comparable ranking.

entries.name: Chavara Public Library and Learning Spaces
entries.details: Lending, public reading and paid study · Amalapuri
entries.description: Chavara describes a lending library, children's and reference sections, a newspaper reading room and separate learning spaces for students and exam preparation.
entries.address: Chavara Cultural Centre, Amalapuri P.O., near 4th Railway Gate, Kozhikode 673001

facts.label: Reading and study
facts.value: The public reading room is for newspapers and periodicals; the learning spaces use a monthly fee. Confirm access and seats.

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: The general library lends to members; ask for current membership terms.

entries.name: Desaposhini Public Library
entries.description: Desaposhini is a public library in Kuthiravattom with a reading room. Contact the library for current access and borrowing conditions.

facts.label: Reading and study
facts.value: Reading room listed; ask whether personal study materials and laptops are permitted.

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: Membership and current fees should be confirmed with the library.

entries.name: ECHO Study Space
entries.details: Paid study space · YMCA Cross Road
entries.description: A dedicated study room; its operator lists 24-hour access, Wi-Fi and flexible memberships for focused work and exam preparation.
entries.address: Second Floor, Epahs Tower, YMCA Cross Road, Kozhikode 673001

facts.label: Access
facts.value: The operator lists 24/7 access for its study space; check plan terms and availability.

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: A book-lending service is not confirmed.

entries.name: Elevate Study Space
entries.description: A study room near Kozhikode railway station offering bookable seats for short and longer study sessions.
entries.address: Royal Palace Building, Link Road, near Kozhikode Railway Station, Kozhikode

facts.label: Access
facts.value: The operator lists three-hour, daily, weekly and longer plans and app-based booking; confirm prices and seats.

facts.label: Borrowing
facts.value: A lending collection is not confirmed.

entries.name: State Public Library and Research Centre
entries.description: A public library and research centre near Mananchira. Local readers also discuss using its reading space; confirm the present entry and membership rules directly.

facts.label: Reading and study
facts.value: Reading-room access, seat availability and fees should be confirmed with the library.

facts.label: Borrowing
